agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements and granted full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their 2025 management and supervision.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved a cash dividend of Rp43.00 per share from the 2025 net profit and allocated Rp13,648,067,094 to the reserve fund.
Agenda #3: The meeting reappointed the existing Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, including Rustiyan Oen as President Director, for terms effective until 2029.
Agenda #4: The 2026 remuneration for the Board of Commissioners was capped at 1% of 2025 net revenue, and the Board was authorized to determine Director salaries.
Agenda #5: The firm Amir Abadi Jusuf, Aryanto, Mawar dan Rekan and accountant Eishennoraz were appointed to audit the 2026 financial statements.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved a share buyback plan with a maximum budget of Rp1,000,000,000,000 and authorized the Board of Directors to execute the transfer of shares.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align business activities with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI).
